designPrompt: Create one portrait 3:4 design sheet for a leaded stained glass puzzle, shooting star with a curved tail (Kayan Yildiz). Subject silhouette is graceful and bold; subdivide star with two offset outline-to-outline seams, never a central radial hub; tail consists of broad alternating flowing segments. Exactly four flat saturated glass colours: golden yellow #F2C230 and amber orange #E87924 exclusively in star and tail; deep blue #245A91 and teal #249C9B exclusively in the background. No text, symbols, signature, or watermark. Priority is low pane count and a clearly recognizable shooting star.
